tools.name: get_passport
tools.description: Read a Passport someone shared with you, by the observation ID in its link (/passport/<targetKey>/observations/<observationId>). Example: {"observationId":"<UUID>"}.

tools.name: check_tool
tools.description: Read the stored facts and effect classes for one MCP tool, with a signature; never a verdict. No live inspection. A few free checks per day work without a key on /mcp/public: a shared pool of 300 per UTC day and 5 per minute globally. Optional network limits (off by default): 10 per UTC day and 5 pe

tools.name: check_tools
tools.description: Check 1 to 50 tools for a goal using stored public facts, never a verdict or live inspection. sinceTime is the goal start in RFC 3339 UTC; since maps endpoint#tool to fingerprints. Returns complete signed checks, unsigned changedSinceTime flags and a separately signed summary. Each tool consumes one

tools.name: watch_tools
tools.description: Watch a goal's tools, or the services a small tool depends on, using stored public facts, never a verdict. No live inspection. Requires an agent key or an account token with record:read in Authorization; get a key: POST https://interfacedelta.com/api/v1/agent-keys. 1–50 tools; default lifetime 30 da

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List the caller's active watches, bounded at 20. Requires an agent key or account token with record:read; get a key: POST https://interfacedelta.com/api/v1/agent-keys. 1–50 tools; default lifetime 30 days, maximum 90 days; at most 20 active watches and 50 creations per principal per UTC day; creatio

tools.name: stop_watch
tools.description: End the caller's own watch early. Idempotent, including unknown IDs. Requires an agent key or account token with record:read; get a key: POST https://interfacedelta.com/api/v1/agent-keys. 1–50 tools; default lifetime 30 days, maximum 90 days; at most 20 active watches and 50 creations per principal

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Report a record problem, tool problem or feature request for a person to review. Requires a free agent key or Record API key with record:read in Authorization. At most 5 reports per key and 50 total per UTC day; identical observed text per key is refused for 24 hours. observed and suggested_fix: 2,0

tools.name: search_atlas
tools.description: Search the public service atlas; omit query to browse. Example: {"query":"rupturebrief"}.

tools.name: get_atlas_entry
tools.description: Read an atlas entry, labels and publicly displayed AI readings. Returns a short summary by default; pass view: "full" for the complete record. Example: {"target":"rupturebrief.com"}.

tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: Read-only public domain summary, matching host and subdomains, up to 10 services per page. No key or Record API quota. Example: {"domain":"example.com"}.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: Read-only recorded atlas changes strictly after since, oldest first. No key or Record API quota. Example: {"since":"2026-11-01T00:00:00Z","domain":"example.com"}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_tool, watch_tools, list_watches, stop_watch, report_issue · Private data: check_tool, check_tools, watch_tools, list_watches, stop_watch, report_issue, get_atlas_entry, lookup_domain, list_changes · Public sink: check_tool, check_tools, watch_tools, list_watches, stop_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_tool, watch_tools, list_watches, stop_watch, report_issue · Private data: check_tool, check_tools, watch_tools, list_watches, stop_watch, report_issue, get_atlas_entry, lookup_domain, list_changes · Public sink: check_tool, check_tools, watch_tools, list_watches, stop_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_passport" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read a recorded Passport by observation ID from history. Example: {"observationId":"<UUID>"}." → after: "Read a Passport someone shared with you, by the observation ID in its link (/passport/<targetKey>/observations/<observationId>). Example: {"observationId":"<UUID>"}."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
